scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w @plan/api" "npm run dev -w @plan/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @plan/api && npm run build -w @plan/web
scripts.test:db: RUN_DB_TESTS=1 NODE_ENV=test node --env-file=.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/integration.test.ts
scripts.test:browser:isolated: node scripts/check-runtime.cjs && npm run build -w @plan/api && node --env-file=.env scripts/test-isolated-db.cjs --browser
scripts.test:http:isolated: node scripts/check-runtime.cjs && npm run build -w @plan/api && node --env-file=.env scripts/test-isolated-db.cjs --http
